title: Plux analytics: missing translations
description: Sampled l10n_missing events by locale (I18N-006, ANL-020).

list.name: organization
list.label: Organisation ID
list.description: The organisation UUID. Row-level security binds every query to it (SRV-022).

list.name: app
list.label: App
list.description: The apps of the organisation with rollups.

list.name: release
list.label: Release sequence
list.description: The release sequences of the selected apps with rollups.

options.content: **Not shown per key.** l10n_missing carries the translation key (Appendix G.2), but the rollups have no key dimension, so the panels group by locale only. The event is also not yet in the telemetry catalogue, so the panels stay empty until it is ingested. The events are sampled (I18N-006).

panels.title: Missing translations by locale
panels.description: l10n_missing events per requested locale over time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.bucket, $__interval), r.locale AS metric, SUM(r.events) AS value
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'l10n_missing'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Missing translations by locale
panels.description: l10n_missing events per locale in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT set_config('plux.organization_id', ${organization:sqlstring}, false);
SELECT r.locale AS "Locale", SUM(r.events) AS "Events"
FROM analytics_rollups r
WHERE r.organization_id = NULLIF(${organization:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
  AND r.granularity = ${granularity:sqlstring}
  AND $__timeFilter(r.bucket)
  AND r.app_id::text IN ($app)
  AND r.release_sequence::text IN ($release)
  AND r.event_name = 'l10n_missing'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 100;
